# ⛔ Generated by the shadcn CLI — do not edit

Every file in this folder (and `src/styles/shadcn.css`) is owned by the shadcn CLI.
It is overwritten by `pnpm shadcn:update`, so any hand edit will be lost.

To customise, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md#customising-shadcn-use-the-first-that-works):
tokens in `src/styles/theme.css` → wrap in `src/components/` → fork into `src/components/` under a new name.
